description: This Kotlin source file defines an adapter class `PosterAdapter` for binding a list of poster items into a RecyclerView, along with the data class `PosterItem`. The adapter inflates item views, binds images to UI using Coil, handles item clicks, and updates its data set. It is part of a mobile frontend module in an Android project.

classes.name: PosterAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding poster items into a RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the poster item view layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a PosterItem to the view, loads image with Coil, and sets click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the adapter.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data list and notifies RecyclerView to refresh.

classes.name: PosterItem
classes.description: Data class representing a poster item with id, name, and poster URL.

methods.description: Inflates layout for poster item view.

methods.description: Binds poster data to the view holder, loads image, and handles click.

methods.description: Returns size of the poster item list.
